{{Otheruses|Overseer}}
An '''Overseer''' was a rank within [[The Crucible]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] organization. Overseers were slaves themselves, but were tasked with the responsibility of supervising the duels of other slaves. Notable Overseers included [[Chantique]] and [[Jarael]].
